_meta.description: Weapon Class x Tier. 5 classes, 4 tiers (Mythic removed). Tier scaling multipliers are LOCKED in Constants.WEAPON_TIER_SCALING; only each class's Common BASE stats are tuned here.
_meta.status: SECOND-PASS BALANCED (2026-07-31, pre-playtest) — Common base stats retuned to close the class DPS spread and remove the Legendary Hammer two-shot. Tier scaling still applied at runtime and still LOCKED. Values remain provisional until playtesting.
_meta.schema_note: Each class has a 'base' object read by WeaponBase.init_from_data(): damage, swing_speed (attacks/sec), durability (hits before breaking), range (pixels).
_meta._balanced: 2026-07-05 first-pass; 2026-07-31 second pass — testable values pending playtesting
_meta._tier_scaling_locked: WEAPON_TIER_SCALING lives in Constants.gd and is marked LOCKED in CLAUDE.md. The 2026-07-31 pass therefore did NOT touch the multipliers, even though the brief listed weapon tier scaling as tunable: weapon tier GAPS can only be changed by editing that locked table. Common base stats are the only weapon lever available in data.
_meta._balance_note: DPS at Common (dmg x swing): Daggers 23.4 | Swords 25.5 | Hammers 22.4 | Spears 21.75 | Axes 25.0. Spread tightened from 1.26x (20.25-25.5) to 1.17x. Classes differentiated by burst-per-hit, reach, and durability rather than raw DPS.
_meta._lowest_per_hit_invariant: Daggers Common 9.0 is the LOWEST per-hit damage in the game. armor_stats.json max total flat_reduction (Legendary 4 + Titan Bulwark 2 = 6) must stay strictly below it — PlayerStats.take_damage() does maxf(amount - flat, 0.0), so flat >= per-hit damage means literal immunity. Do not raise armor flat past 8 without raising this.

passives._meta: Weapon passive magnitudes, implemented 2026-07-31 (previously name-only strings with no code behind them). ALL VALUES ARE FIRST-PASS TBD PLACEHOLDERS — no playtesting. Read by WeaponPassives.gd via GameManager.data['weapons']['passives'].
passives._tier_rule: One passive per weapon, not cumulative: Epic gets its class's MINOR passive, Legendary gets its class's UNIQUE passive INSTEAD (Constants.WEAPON_TIER_SCALING stores a single 'passive' string per tier: '' / 'minor' / 'unique'). A Legendary Dagger therefore has Assassin's Mark but NOT Serrated Edge. If Legendary should stack both, that is a design change to the locked tier table, not to this file.
passives._null_safety: Every value here is read with a documented fallback; a missing or null field makes that passive a no-op rather than an error.
